extracted_formulas.name: Bet record win-rate calculation (client-side analytics)
extracted_formulas.reconstruction: A bet is LOSS if any leg graded LOSS, PUSH if all legs PUSH, else WIN; win rate % = wins / (wins + losses) * 100, shown to 2 decimals. Pushes excluded from denominator.

extracted_formulas.name: OddsTrader Picks signal set (marketing-defined, no formula in client)
extracted_formulas.raw_snippet: AI prediction: Projected score or outcome generated from OddsTrader's data model. Expected value: A signal that compares the market price to the model's view of the outcome. Cover probability: The model's estimated chance that a side, spread or total reaches the required result. Bet rating: A quick ranking signal ...
